adjudication.rationale: In EventManager.ts within the new loop over `calendarReference` (around lines ~493-570), when `reference.credentialId` is present it sets `credential = this.calendarCredentials.filter(...)[0]` and, if falsy, attempts a DB fetch. However, after the DB fetch it unconditionally calls `result.push(updateEvent(credential, event, ...))` without re-checking that `credential` is defined. If the credential is missing in memory and the DB lookup fails/returns null, `updateEvent` is invoked with `undefined`, which will throw and be caught by the outer try/catch—aborting updates for remaining references. This differs from `createAllCalendarEvents`, which explicitly guards with `if (credential)` before calling `createEvent`.
